candidates.title: 'Orchestrated at Elon Musk's behest': Brij Bhushan on CJP's Tiranga march
Democracy does not end after polls, says CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke
candidates.excerpt: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke defended peaceful protests as a democratic right, accusing the government of restricting freedoms through shutdowns and internet suspensions. He said the party remained committed to non-violence and urged citizens to hold elected representatives accountable

candidates.title: Amit Shah Seeks Punjab Govt Response Over Drug-Related Incidents
candidates.excerpt: The Union Home Minister cited the death of Gulzar Singh in Dirba and the killing of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota in Mansa, raising concerns over Punjab’s law and order.

candidates.title: ‘Forgive your enemies once, friends twice, but never traitors’: Kiren Rijiju on ‘regime change’ remark
candidates.excerpt: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju criticised advocates of “regime change” following senior advocate Prashant Bhushan’s remarks. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh also accused protesters of seeking power through disorder, triggering a political exchange over democratic institutions and constitutional principles
